shortDescription: German luxury carmaker Mercedes-Benz XETR:MBG said on Wednesday sales in its core car business continued to fall in the third quarter, declining 8% year-on-year due to challenging market conditions in China.

children: said on Wednesday sales in its core car business continued to fall in the third quarter, declining 8% year-on-year due to challenging market conditions in China.
Car deliveries fell to 407,200 units in the July-September period, the company said in a statement.
In China, the drop was 31% to 86,800 units, compared with the same period last year.
Quarterly sales in Top-End segment dropped 21% to 53,900 units, affected by the weaker market environment in China and ongoing model changeovers.
However, car sales rose by 6% in the U.S. and 5% in Europe.
Group sales of battery-electric vehicles, which include cars and vans, rose by 52% to 78,100 units.
